item.title: Kollman, Hoornaert Garner All-State Honors
item.description: CARRINGTON (NewsDakota)- After a 31-win debut season under head coach Kadyn Mehring, two Carrington Cardinal Volleyball stars, junior Harper Kollman and sophomore Aniston Hoornaert, have been named Second-Team All-State in Class A, as announced on Tuesday morning.
